exposure: Pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) - underweight, normal, overweight, obese
finding: Higher pre-pregnancy BMI was associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including GDM, macrosomia, cesarean section, preeclampsia, and postpartum hemorrhage, even after adjusting for GDM status.
mod_finding: The study found that higher pre-pregnancy BMI was associated with a higher prevalence of Cesarean section delivery.
